source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 1 (ISLB A1) · lesson 9. Exercises reused from the lesson.
topic: Saying Bismillah before everything we do

learn.en: Bismillahir-Rahmanir-Raheem means: In the name of Allah, the Most Kind, the Most Merciful.
learn.title: What it means

learn.en: It is a verse of the Qur'an, and every surah begins with it except Surah 9 (At-Tawbah).
learn.title: In the Qur'an

learn.en: The Prophet ﷺ taught us to start every good thing with Bismillah, so Allah blesses it.
learn.title: Start with Bismillah

learn.en: Say it before wudu, drinking, putting on clothes and shoes, opening the door, getting in the car, and sleeping.
learn.title: Many times a day

learn.en: Forgot it before eating? Just say: Bismillahi fi awwalihi wa akhirihi — in the name of Allah at its beginning and its end.
learn.title: If you forget

learn.en: Saying Bismillah shows we need Allah's help, and it turns normal habits into worship.
learn.title: Why it matters

words.en: the Most Kind (a name of Allah)
the Most Merciful (a name of Allah)

quiz.en: Every surah begins with Bismillah EXCEPT one. Which?
You forgot Bismillah and you're already eating! What should you do?
When is a good time to say Bismillah?
opts: Before everyday things like shoes, water and the car

quiz.en: True or false? Saying Bismillah is our way of admitting we need Allah's help.
True or false? We should only say Bismillah for big, difficult tasks, not small things like opening a door.

think.q: Getting ready for school: clothes, shoes, backpack, the door, the bus. What can you whisper at each step?
think.a: Bismillah! It wraps your whole morning in Allah's blessing.

parents.summary: Bismillah before everything: what it means, where it is in the Qur'an, and what to say if you forget before eating.
parents.tip: Make a game today: whoever remembers Bismillah first before an action gets a point.
